accepted.note: One actual authenticated agent admission, native target claim and accepted/uncertain outcome, excluding active-turn setup

accepted-100-retries.note: One hundred identical actual startTurn retries and queue reads; no native resend

confirmation-uncertain.note: One actual authenticated agent admission, native target claim and accepted/uncertain outcome, excluding active-turn setup

confirmation-uncertain-100-retries.note: One hundred identical actual startTurn retries and queue reads; no native resend

graceful-stop.note: Stop one original owner, one accepted interjection and one waiting new turn without replay

native-terminal.note: One provider terminal settles the original owner and one accepted interjection

native-uncertain.note: One actual authenticated agent admission, native target claim and accepted/uncertain outcome, excluding active-turn setup

native-uncertain-100-retries.note: One hundred identical actual startTurn retries and queue reads; no native resend

non-owner-interrupt-100.note: One hundred attempts to interrupt through an interjection identity; no native control or writes

recover.note: The existing recovery transaction settles original, steered and waiting jobs without replay

refused-claim-stop.note: A refused claim shuts down the owner and retires input restored after the first cancellation sweep
